title: Arithmetic Search Case Study: Verified MAC Benchmarks and a Negative Frontier Result
description:
A completed arithmetic topology-search experiment, released as software, exact multiply-accumulate benchmarks, verification tools, selected synthesis/global-route evidence, and a short negative-result report.

A bounded prior-art-derived control is 8.13% faster and 0.21% smaller than the evolved candidate in the tested default flow, eliminating its earlier finite-set Pareto-frontier advantage. The comparison uses ARITH-DAS's UFO-MAC compressor replication with an adapted full-output contract and a time-limited solver; it does not reproduce either complete method's best performance.

The research line is closed. No novel architecture, state-of-the-art performance, physical signoff, fabricated-silicon result, or peer review is claimed. Development and writing used AI coding assistance. Vendored ARITH-DAS code retains its MIT license; original local material is Apache-2.0.
